The '''repeating blaster carbine''' was a short-range autofire weapon similar to a [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster]]. It could only shoot in autofire mode, firing multiple shots in rapid succession at a greater area instead of the more accurate single-shot mode. It had difficulty hitting targets at longer ranges, thus making it ineffective against distant targets.

A repeating blaster carbine required a [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] to operate; after 30 shots, the power pack needed to be replaced. The repeating blaster carbine cost 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase, but it was restricted to military use only.
